name: ShopRaise Workplace Giving
summary: Employee giving perk: staff shop through partner retailers and a portion of eligible purchases supports the cause they pick, with no payroll deductions or donation budget.
best_for: HR and people teams at employers of any size that want a giving or social-impact perk without payroll deductions, employee donations or a company-funded donation budget
skip_if: you want matched donations, payroll giving or volunteer tracking, or you need independent buyer reviews and published terms before you spend anything
honest_knock: We could not read ShopRaise's own pricing page, so the only price is the G2 listing that ShopRaise supplied. The G2 profile showed no reviews when we read it, and the SHRM directory entry has none either, so there is no buyer feedback to lean on. The listings do not say what share of a purchase supports the cause, which retailers take part, or how long the contract runs.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-18 on the G2 pricing tab for ShopRaise Workplace Giving; the listing says the pricing is provided by ShopRaise; prices in US dollars) ShopRaise sells a single package called All-In at $2 per employee per month. G2 says employers pay a per-employee, per-month fee for one all-inclusive package with no separate tiers, add-ons or implementation fees, and that ShopRaise also offers a free trial. G2 also says ShopRaise does not require a company-funded rewards or donation budget, and that final cost negotiations must be conducted with the seller. ShopRaise's own site (wpgiving.shopraise.com) returned a country block from Amazon CloudFront when we tried it, so we could not check the figure on the vendor's own pricing page.

compare_with.name: Rippling
compare_with.why: Rippling is a workforce platform that runs HR, IT and finance, including payroll. ShopRaise is not an HR system. It adds one giving perk next to the HR tool you already use, so the two are not alternatives
